{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expense divided by sales over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D intensity may be more likely to experience sudden changes in their competitive position, leading to higher expected returns. This volatility can capture the uncertainty associated with innovative activities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "percentage of total sales accounted for by the top 5 customers, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration may be exposed to greater risk, as the loss of a major customer can have a significant impact on their financial performance. This concentration can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "number of unique suppliers divided by total cost of goods sold, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may face greater challenges in managing their operations, leading to higher expected returns. This complexity can capture the uncertainty associated with sourcing and logistics.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Turnover Rate", "construction": "average annual turnover rate of employees over the past 4 years", "rationale": "Firms with high employee turnover rates may experience disruptions to their operations and knowledge base, leading to higher expected returns. This turnover can capture the uncertainty associated with human capital.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Pending Ratio", "construction": "number of patent applications pending divided by total R&D expense, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with a high patent pending ratio may be more likely to experience future growth and innovation, leading to higher expected returns. This ratio can capture the potential for future technological advancements.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Segment Diversity", "construction": "Herfindahl index of sales across different geographic segments, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with diverse geographic sales may be less exposed to country-specific risks, leading to lower expected returns. This diversity can capture the benefits of international diversification.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Overlap", "construction": "number of board members serving on multiple boards divided by total number of board members, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with high board member overlap may experience greater challenges in governance and decision-making, leading to higher expected returns. This overlap can capture the potential for conflicts of interest.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "total environmental liability divided by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liability may face greater risks and uncertainties, leading to higher expected returns. This liability can capture the potential for future environmental costs and regulations.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Lifecycle Stage", "construction": "average age of products divided by total number of products, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with products in the growth stage of their lifecycle may experience higher growth rates and higher expected returns. This stage can capture the potential for future innovation and expansion.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Operating Lease Off-Balance-Sheet Financing", "construction": "total operating lease obligations divided by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high operating lease off-balance-sheet financing may be more likely to experience financial distress, leading to higher expected returns. This financing can capture the potential for hidden liabilities and risks.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
